fred.publication: One value per business day, dated by the trading day; missing days (holidays) are absent. The value dated d is published after d's close, so on forecast date T the latest row is dated T-1 or earlier.
fred.title: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), fredgraph.csv, no API key

open-meteo.publication: One value per UTC day. The snapshot holds every day before T; the real archive runs a few days behind, so a forecaster on T would have had slightly less. Recent days can be revised when preliminary reanalysis is replaced by the final one.
open-meteo.title: Open-Meteo historical weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com, ERA5-based reanalysis), no API key

usgs.publication: Events counted per UTC day of their origin time; a day with no event counts 0. Reviewed catalogues can add or re-rate events for weeks; the counts are as fetched.
usgs.title: USGS FDSN event web service (earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1), CSV, no API key

wikimedia.publication: Daily views by human (user) agents, dated by UTC day, published the next day.
wikimedia.title: Wikimedia REST pageviews API (per-article, en.wikipedia, all-access, user agents), no API key
